verification: Two targeted server-side unit tests passed. Full same-case execution and independent E are still required before counting case 029 as validated.
audit_rule: Original failed attempts stay recorded. New processes use this deployed adapter; old failed cases require same-case reruns, and independently measured raster checks must pass before replacing an initial outcome in final per-case accounting.
